page.layout: One page of text, running head at top with page number at top right; below the text the word FINIS, then a printer's ornament (fleuron).

p.i: temporibus famem extremi & jam jam futuri judicii signum fore. Jubet nos capita levare & bono animo esse, atque ita nos comparare, ut coram tribunali eius apparere valeamus, & cum ipso omnibusque electis, ex fame aliisque miseriis liberati, vitam æternam ingrediamur.

page.notes: The printer's ornament below FINIS is a fleuron, not text, so it is not transcribed. Spaced capitals in FINIS are set roman. The page carries no catchword or signature. The first line is a fragment continuing the previous page. Spelling is kept as printed except for u/v and i/j, per the rules: "iam" to "jam", "Iubet" to "Jubet", "iudicij" to "judicii", "vt" to "ut", "valeamus" to "valeamus". The first "iam" and the "iudicij" are read clearly from the scan; no reading is uncertain.
